# Little Star Mandarin School
> Mandarin Chinese classes and Chinese culture programs for children in La Canyada, Paterna, and Valencia.

## Main Pages
- [English homepage](https://www.littlemandarinstar.com/): Mandarin Chinese classes for children in Valencia.
- [Spanish page](https://www.littlemandarinstar.com/es/): Spanish-language page for Mandarin classes in Valencia.
- [French page](https://www.littlemandarinstar.com/fr/): French-language page for Mandarin classes in Valencia.
- [Russian page](https://www.littlemandarinstar.com/ru/): Russian-language page for Mandarin classes in Valencia.

## Programs
- [Mandarin for Beginners](https://www.littlemandarinstar.com/#courses): friendly classes for children starting with Chinese sounds, words, and characters.
- [Long-Term Learning](https://www.littlemandarinstar.com/#courses): structured lessons for steady progress, confidence, and daily conversation practice.
- [Culture Programs](https://www.littlemandarinstar.com/#courses): Chinese culture activities for schools, groups, and extra-curriculum programs.
